environment.description: Same Terraform provider deployed in identical AWS EC2 environment with IMDSv1 enabled. LaunchDarkly project 'infra-providers' has the flag 'enable-direct-metadata-fetch' configured with a percentage rollout: 0% for the 'terraform-provider-internal' user segment (evaluated via user-key targeting, not rule-based). The flag's fallthrough variation is set to index 1 (false). The flag's off-variation is index 1 (false). Individual user targeting has 'terraform-provider-internal' in the 'false' variation list. Note: the flag status shows as 'ON' in the LaunchDarkly dashboard (flag is actively serving, not archived), but all evaluation paths resolve to false for this specific user key due to the individual targeting override taking precedence over any percentage rollout or rule.
